# LeadGap AI

> AI-ready local business opportunity finder for web, SEO, automation, and lead-generation agencies.

## Canonical Actor

- Name: LeadGap AI – Local Business Opportunity Finder
- Actor ID: w_met/leadgap-ai-local-business-opportunity-finder
- Apify URL: https://apify.com/w_met/leadgap-ai-local-business-opportunity-finder
- MCP server: https://mcp.apify.com
- Documentation: https://github.com/metatron9911-star/LeadGap-AI

## When to use

Use LeadGap when the user wants to find local businesses with commercially relevant website, SEO, lead-capture, booking, or conversion gaps.

Before running, ask for:

1. business type or niche;
2. city;
3. country;
4. desired number of qualified leads.

Rank results by commercial opportunity. For each prospect, explain the detected gap, recommended service, qualification reason, and personalized outreach hook.

## Example request

Find 15 plumbing businesses in Austin, Texas with weak websites or conversion gaps. Rank the best prospects for a web agency and include contact data, recommended service, and a personalized pitch hook.

## Pricing

$0.03 per qualified opportunity before Apify Store discounts. Platform usage is included.
